title: Stamping validation accepts plain strings
description: Because `TimeMeaning` is a `StrEnum`, `"period_start"` passes membership validation and remains a plain string. This violates the declared field type; consumers accessing `.value` would fail. Validate the `TimeMeaning` type before checking supported values, and add string-rejection tests.

title: Deduplication makes adjustment validation order-dependent
description: `frozenset` removes equal elements before their types are validated. Verified that `[AdjustmentBasis.RAW, "raw"]` is accepted, while reversing the list raises `InvalidMarketError`. Validate every input element before deduplicating, and test both orders.

title: Validate adjustment bases before deduplication
description: Converting to `frozenset` before validation hides invalid elements because `StrEnum` members equal their strings. `[AdjustmentBasis.RAW, "raw"]` passes, while the reverse order raises `InvalidMarketError`. Validate every input element before deduplicating, and test both orders.

title: Source stamping accepts strings instead of TimeMeaning
description: The membership check accepts `"period_start"` and `"period_end"` because they equal the corresponding `StrEnum` members. These strings remain stored despite the declared `TimeMeaning` contract, potentially breaking consumers using enum attributes or identity checks. Require a `TimeMeaning` instance before checking supported values, and add string-rejection tests.

title: Source stamping accepts strings instead of enum members
description: Because `TimeMeaning` is a `StrEnum`, `"period_start"` passes the membership check and remains stored as a plain string. This violates the declared field type and permits failures when consumers access `.value`. Validate `TimeMeaning` membership by type before checking allowed values, and add string-rejection tests.

title: Deduplication hides invalid adjustment bases
description: Validation occurs after conversion to `frozenset`. Reproduced: `[AdjustmentBasis.RAW, "raw"]` is accepted, while reversing those elements raises `InvalidMarketError`. The enum and string compare equal, so deduplication can discard the invalid input before validation. Validate each original element before building the frozenset; test both orders.

title: Validate adjustment bases before deduplication
description: `frozenset(bases)` runs before element validation. Because `AdjustmentBasis.RAW == "raw"`, `[AdjustmentBasis.RAW, "raw"]` silently passes, while the reversed list raises `InvalidMarketError`. Reproduced both outcomes. Validate each input element before constructing the frozenset, and test both orders.

title: Source stamping accepts strings instead of TimeMeaning
description: Membership alone does not enforce the enum type: `"period_start"` compares equal to `TimeMeaning.PERIOD_START`. Reproduced construction retaining a plain string, violating the declared field contract. Require a `TimeMeaning` instance before checking supported values, and add rejection tests for raw strings.
